root_cause.text: The RCU-protected codepaths (mpls_forward, mpls_dump_routes) read the platform_labels size and platform_label pointer separately without synchronization, so a concurrent resize (which updates both under platform_mutex) can cause an inconsistent view, leading to out-of-bounds access when the stale size is used with the updated pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The RCU-protected codepaths (mpls_forward, mpls_dump_routes) can have an inconsistent view of platform_labels vs platform_label in case of a concurrent resize (resize_platform_label_table, under platform_mutex). This can lead to OOB accesses." The patch adds a seqcount to ensure a consistent snapshot, modifying `mpls_route_input_rcu` and `mpls_dump_routes` to both read platform_label and platform_labels under the seqcount.
